classes.name: IFGraph_AllConnected
classes.summary: this class gives content of the CONNECTED COMPONENT(S) which include specific Entity(ies)

instanceMethods.name: ResetData
instanceMethods.comment: Allows to restart on a new data set.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: does the specific evaluation (Connected entities atall levels)

classes.name: IFGraph_AllShared
classes.summary: this class determines all Entities shared by some specific ones, at any level (those which will be lead in a Transfer for instance)

instanceMethods.name: ResetData
instanceMethods.comment: Allows to restart on a new data set.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: does the specific evaluation (shared entities atall levels)

classes.name: IFGraph_Articulations
classes.summary: this class gives entities which are Articulation points in a whole Model or in a sub-part An Articulation Point divides the graph in two (or more) disconnected sub-graphs Identifying Articulation Points allows improving efficiency of splitting a set of Entities into sub-sets

instanceMethods.name: ResetData
instanceMethods.comment: Allows to restart on a new data set.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: Evaluates the list of Articulation points.

classes.name: IFGraph_Compare
classes.summary: this class evaluates effect of two compared sub-parts : cumulation (union), common part (intersection-overlapping) part specific to first sub-part or to the second one Results are kept in a Graph, several question can be set Basic Iteration gives Cumulation (union)

instanceMethods.name: Merge
instanceMethods.comment: merges the second list into the first one, hence the second list is empty

instanceMethods.name: RemoveSecond
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the contents of second list.

instanceMethods.name: KeepCommon
instanceMethods.comment: Keeps only Common part, sets it as First list and clears second list.

instanceMethods.name: ResetData
instanceMethods.comment: Allows to restart on a new data set.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: Recomputes result of comparing to sub-parts.

classes.name: IFGraph_ConnectedComponants
classes.summary: determines Connected Components in a Graph. They define disjoined sets of Entities.

classes.name: IFGraph_Cumulate
classes.summary: this class evaluates effect of cumulated sub-parts : overlapping, forgotten entities Results are kept in a Graph, several question can be set Basic Iteration gives entities which are part of Cumulation

instanceMethods.name: ResetData
instanceMethods.comment: Allows to restart on a new data set.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: Evaluates the result of cumulation.

instanceMethods.name: NbTimes
instanceMethods.comment: returns number of times an Entity has been counted (0 means forgotten, more than 1 means overlap, 1 is normal)

instanceMethods.name: HighestNbTimes
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the highest number of times recorded for every Entity (0 means empty, 1 means no overlap).

classes.name: IFGraph_Cycles
classes.summary: determines strong components in a graph which are Cycles

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: creates from a StrongComponants which was already computed

classes.name: IFGraph_ExternalSources
classes.summary: this class gives entities which are Source of entities of a sub-part, but are not contained by this sub-part

instanceMethods.name: ResetData
instanceMethods.comment: Allows to restart on a new data set.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: Evaluates external sources of a set of entities.

instanceMethods.name: IsEmpty
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if no External Source are found It means that we have a "root" set (performs an Evaluation as necessary).

classes.name: IFGraph_SCRoots
classes.summary: determines strong components in a graph which are Roots

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: creates from a StrongComponants which was already computed

classes.name: IFGraph_StrongComponants
classes.summary: determines strong components of a graph, that is isolated entities (single components) or loops

classes.name: IFGraph_SubPartsIterator
classes.summary:
defines general form for graph classes of which result is not a single iteration on Entities, but a nested one : External iteration works on sub-parts, identified by each class (according to its algorithm) Internal Iteration concerns Entities of a sub-part Sub-Parts are assumed to be disjoined; if they are not, the first one has priority
A SubPartsIterator can work in two steps : first, load entities which have to be processed then, analyse to set those entities into sub-parts

instanceMethods.name: AddPart
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an empty part and sets it to receive entities.

instanceMethods.name: NbParts
instanceMethods.comment: Returns count of registered parts.

instanceMethods.name: PartNum
instanceMethods.comment: Returns numero of part which currently receives entities (0 at load time).

instanceMethods.name: SetLoad
instanceMethods.comment: Sets SubPartIterator to get Entities (by GetFromEntity & GetFromIter) into load status, to be analysed later.

instanceMethods.name: SetPartNum
instanceMethods.comment: Sets numero of receiving part to a new value Error if not in range (1-NbParts).

instanceMethods.name: GetFromEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an Entity : into load status if in Load mode, to the current part if there is one. If shared is True, adds also its shared ones (shared at all levels).

instanceMethods.name: Reset
instanceMethods.comment: Erases data (parts, entities) : "me" becomes empty and in load status.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: Called by Clear, this method allows evaluation just before iteration; its default is doing nothing, it is designed to be redefined.

instanceMethods.name: Loaded
instanceMethods.comment: Returns entities which where loaded (not set into a sub-part).

instanceMethods.name: IsLoaded
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if an Entity is loaded (either set into a sub-part or not).

instanceMethods.name: IsInPart
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if an Entity is Present in a sub-part.

instanceMethods.name: EntityPartNum
instanceMethods.comment: Returns number of the sub-part in which an Entity has been set if it is not in a sub-part (or not loaded at all), Returns 0.

instanceMethods.name: Start
instanceMethods.comment: Sets iteration to its beginning; calls Evaluate.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if there are more sub-parts to iterate on Note : an empty sub-part is not taken in account by Iteration.

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Sets iteration to the next sub-part if there is not, IsSingle-Entities will raises an exception.

instanceMethods.name: IsSingle
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if current sub-part is single (has only one Entity) Error if there is no sub-part to iterate now.

instanceMethods.name: FirstEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first entity of current sub-part, that is for a Single one, the only one it contains Error : same as above (end of iteration).
